messages.text:
Did you not read my previous email?

In it I said that I had received notification of a shipment of 1 (one)
NerdQaxe, not 2 (two), only 1 (one).

1. When will I receive the second shipment?
2. Thanks for the code.
3. You’re correct, I ordered and received a Hammer Thor X1. I have an order
in for another Hammer Thor X1.
I accept your offer to swap and send a Hammer BC04.
4. What is your offer for all the th/s I’ve forfeited due to all the
delays, lost orders, bad equipment, etc?
Note to the team: I'll pull the facts before answering.
Handed to the team · compensation beyond my limit needs a person to decide

Hi Tom,

Taking your points in order.

One shipment, two units. Both replacement NerdQaxe++ are on the same order and go out in the same box from our Chattanooga warehouse, so you will get one tracking number covering both, not two separate notifications. The box is being picked now. If only one unit is in it when it lands, tell me and I will put it right that day.

The swap is done. Your open order Shop···· now has a Hammer Miner BC04 (6TH/s) instead of the Thor X1. The B.04 is $30 more and I have waived that, so nothing more to pay and the order sits at zero. It is on the shelf and ships within 2 business days.

Please still send both faulty units back in the one box on the prepaid UPS label, tracking ····, and write Shop···· on the outside.

On the hashrate you have lost through all of this, that is a real question and it is above what I can decide on my own. I have put it in front of Abel and Georges with the full history. They are offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and their answer comes straight back to you in this thread. I am not going to promise you a number I do not control, but I will not let it go quiet again either.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

So your answer to my question of reimbursement for lost hashrate is some
expedited shipping (I'll remind that there wouldn't be any need for
expedited shipping if HD has addressed my issue immediately after I sent in
the RMA. Yet, I had to press several times to get a prepaid label) and a
$30 difference for a BC04 vs a Thor X1? The T. X1 is listed as Sold Out
on the website so I suspect that my original order was misplaced, lost or
whatever and I agreed to take a BC04 because you had one available. I
should have received the $75 off purchase of $100 or more the day I gave
the review as well.

Take this back to whomever and ask again because this isn't enough.
Handed to the team · customer rejected what I can give; real compensation is above my ceiling

Hi Tom,

No, that was not my answer on the lost hashrate, and I can see how it read that way. The waived $30 and the replacements going out ahead of your return were me fixing two things that were our fault in the first place. They were not meant to settle what you lost, and you are right that none of it should have taken this much pushing from you.

Your reimbursement question is with Abel and Georges with the full history on it, including the second order of 602s, the Thor X1 that sat unshipped, the two faulty NerdQaxe++ and the RMA you had to chase. I have gone back to them and said plainly that what is on the table is not enough in your view. They are offline right now and pick it up at 10am ET today, and their answer comes back to you in this thread.

What I can do myself I have done. There is a $25 code on your account for a future order, HD-••••••, good on anything over $100. That is my ceiling, so treat it as separate from whatever they come back with, not as the answer.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
